full_prompt_en: A square photograph of a hanging Flemish-style tapestry shows a wooded landscape woven in muted blue, olive, tan, and warm brown threads. The textile is vertically oriented within the square frame, suspended from a dark rod across the top and ending in a short fringe above the white wall. A narrow patterned border surrounds the central picture on all four sides, its rust and brown motifs setting the scene apart from the plain background. Inside the border, tall leafy trees rise along the left and right edges, making a shaded opening toward the distance. Their woven foliage is dense and blue-green, with small irregular leaves and branches forming a continuous canopy near the upper edge. A pale path begins in the lower foreground and bends toward a far group of buildings or towers. Near the lower middle, several small animals stand or move along the path and grassy bank; their outlines are modest but readable against the lighter ground. Low hills and a soft tan sky recede beyond the trees, with a distant structure placed near the center. The picture has shallow, orderly perspective and many finely patterned surface passages rather than broad smooth paint. Even room light falls across the full hanging cloth, revealing the woven grain and slight waviness of the textile without sharp shadows. The surrounding white wall gives the aged colors room to breathe, and the dark rod provides a simple horizontal cap. The overall composition is a framed, quiet pastoral view whose depth is built through foliage, path, and fine interlocking threads.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形照片呈现一张悬挂的佛兰德式挂毯，蓝、橄榄绿、浅棕和暖褐色纱线织成林间风景。织物在方画框里纵向排列，顶部横过一道深色挂杆，下方以短流苏结束，身后是白墙。窄纹样边框包住中央图景的四边，锈红和棕色花纹把景色与素净背景分开。边框内，高高的茂叶树立在左右两侧，形成通向远处的阴凉开口。编织树叶浓密而蓝绿，小而不规则的叶与枝在上缘附近接成连续树冠。一条浅路从下方前景开始，弯向远处一组建筑或塔楼。下方中央附近，几只小动物站着或沿道路和草岸移动；其轮廓朴素，却能在较浅地面前读清。低丘与柔和浅褐天空退向树后，远处中央附近有一道建筑形。画面透视浅而有序，表面有许多细密纹样区，而非宽阔平滑的颜料。室内均匀光铺满整块织物，揭示织纹和轻微布面起伏，没有硬投影。周围白墙给陈旧色彩留下呼吸空间，深色挂杆提供简单水平顶边。整体构图是一幅被框起的安静田园景观，纵深经树叶、道路和细密交锁的纱线建立。
style_prompt_en: The woven image has a subdued, time-softened palette of dusty blue-green, olive, ochre, tan, and rust brown. Fine interlocking threads and small repeated motifs give every color field a textured, slightly uneven surface. Dense dark masses frame a lighter middle passage, and shallow layered perspective lets detail accumulate without photographic depth. Edges remain readable through changes in thread color rather than hard outlines. Even light reveals the fabric grain and slight waviness while leaving the color gentle. A narrow ornamental border and compact internal rhythm give the whole image a formal, pastoral calm.
style_prompt_zh: 这种编织图像使用经时光柔化的低调色域：带灰蓝绿、橄榄、赭黄、浅棕和锈褐。细密交锁的纱线与重复小纹样让每片色域都带纹理和轻微不平。密集深色块围住较亮的中央通路，浅层透视让细节积累而不形成摄影式纵深。边缘通过纱线色差而非坚硬轮廓保持可辨。均匀光显出织纹与微弱布面起伏，同时维持柔和色彩。窄装饰边框和紧凑内部节奏让整幅图像正式而有田园平静感。
theme_en: A hanging woven tapestry of a quiet wooded pastoral path
theme_zh: 一张悬挂的织物挂毯，描绘安静林间田园小路
name: Flemish tapestry
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
